latest.notes: New in HingeLab: a Parametric design gallery with 60 ready-made sculptures (including slat-wall portraits), a design generator with seeds and variations, a Style panel, a template gallery with 54 ready-to-cut projects, pro vector tools in Studio (Pathfinder, Live Effects, arrays, Shape Builder, Knife, Eraser and more), and fixes for the used-size readout, the box dimensions summary and narrow screens.
